sections.section_title: LTDC line interrupt position configuration register (LTDC_LIPCR)
sections.text_helper: Section 43.7.12 "LTDC line interrupt position configuration register (LTDC_LIPCR)" in chapter 43 (LCD-TFT display controller (LTDC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2126.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x040
Reset value: 0x00000000
This register defines the line interrupt position. The line value to be programmed depends
on timing parameters (see Figure448).
Bits 31:12 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 11:0 LIPOS[11:0]: Line interrupt position
This bitfield configures the line interrupt position.
